name: landing
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, realistic finished Korean Salus diet/meal planning web product UI design image. This is a proposed full redesign. Art direction: independent Korean food editorial meets meticulous useful consumer software, warm offwhite #F7F6F2, ink #232820, deep olive #384B33, hairline warm grey dividers, subtle muted apricot only where useful. Large confident typography, beautifully typeset legible Korean sans UI with an occasional editorial serif for roman Salus wordmark, restrained corner radii 8-12px, precise spacing, very little shadow. Actual credible candid food photography with ceramic tableware and natural light. No purple, neon, gradients, sparkles, robot icon, glassmorphism, excessive pill chips, fake testimonials, invented metrics or medical certification. No vague slogans. Brand wordmark Salus with tiny simple single leaf glyph. All copy in Korean except wordmark and PLUS. Crisp orthographic front facing screen design, no perspective, no laptop/phone hardware frames, no surrounding presentation labels. Large 2400x1600 landscape composition, main desktop screen filling 78% left and a companion narrow mobile responsive screen filling 22% right, separated by a thin neutral gutter. Every UI should feel buildable and orderly. Do not crop controls.
Landing page. Main desktop viewport full page showing nav, spacious editorial hero, and two supporting sections below. Top nav Salus | 이용 방법 | 요금 안내 | 로그인 | 시작하기. Hero left eyebrow 매일의 식사, 나에게 맞게. Main headline in large 2 lines "오늘은 뭘 먹을까요." / "내 몸에 맞춰 골라요." Small copy "취향과 건강 정보를 바탕으로 요리를 찾고, 오늘의 식사로 기록하세요." Primary olive CTA "오늘 먹을 요리 찾기", simple secondary "먼저 둘러보기". Hero right enormous beautiful rectangular editorial photograph of a complete Korean home dinner for one: brown rice, chicken cabbage steamed dish, small vegetable banchan, ivory linen, some natural human imperfection. Overlap only one modest contextual paper strip reading "양배추 닭고기찜 · 20분 · 1인분". Below hero horizontal flow with 3 numbered textual columns "01 나를 알려주고" "02 요리를 고르고" "03 식사로 남겨요" with short supporting lines, generous whitespace not 3 cards. Further below heading "냉장고 속 재료부터 시작해도 좋아요." and small authentic recipe thumbnails in two wide rows. Footer compact links. Mobile presents the exact same responsive landing with headline, CTA then photo and the numbered workflow starting below. Let editorial photography and exact typography carry brand. No fabricated health promises.
